mapper.insert: insert into class_session ( session_no, schedule_no, classroom_no, session_start, session_end ) values( #{sessionNo}, #{scheduleNo}, #{classroomNo}, #{sessionStart}, #{sessionEnd} )

insert into class_session ( session_no, schedule_no, classroom_no, session_start, session_end, session_status ) values( #{sessionNo}, #{scheduleNo}, #{classroomNo}, #{sessionStart}, #{sessionEnd}, #{sessionStatus} )
mapper.update: update class_session set session_status = #{sessionStatus}, session_end = SYSTIMESTAMP where session_no = #{sessionNo}
mapper.select: SELECT c.employee_no FROM class_session cs JOIN schedule sc ON cs.schedule_no = sc.schedule_no JOIN course c ON sc.course_no = c.course_no WHERE cs.session_no = #{sessionNo}
mapper.update: update class_session set session_status = '종료' where session_status = '진행중' and session_end < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT cs.* FROM class_session cs JOIN schedule sc ON cs.schedule_no = sc.schedule_no JOIN registration r ON sc.course_no = r.course_no WHERE r.student_no = #{studentNo} AND cs.session_status = '진행중' AND SYSDATE BETWEEN cs.session_start AND cs.session_end AND ROWNUM = 1
SELECT * FROM class_session WHERE session_status = '진행중' AND session_end < SYSTIMESTAMP
